children: Gulf Air, Bahrain’s national carrier, has cancelled all flights to and from Riyadh (RUH) from October 12 until midnight on October 17.
Affected passengers are advised to contact the Gulf Air Worldwide Contact Centre at +973 17373737 for rebooking options and further assistance.
